regions.region: page 1 title, authors, article metadata, abstract, and graphical abstract
regions.finding: Verified the source title and the current dual-Co/Ni radical 1,4-hydroarylation class. The graphical abstract reports >50 racemic examples and up to 91% yield and is linked to one generic current-scheme record, not treated as experiment-specific runs.

regions.region: page 1 two-column introduction and prior-work discussion
regions.finding: Classified first-row metal-hydride alkene hydrofunctionalization and Carreira enyne hydrohydrazination as cited prior work. The authors' allenyl-Co/Ni concept is mechanistic motivation, not a page-1 preparation.

unresolved: Graphical/prior-work drawings contain generic R/FG groups and do not define unique experiment structures or complete conditions.
The visible online Supporting Information link does not establish workspace SI association.

regions.region: page 2 upper Scheme 1a-c
regions.finding: Visually separated the generic cited MHAT class, cited 1,2-hydrohydrazination, proposed 1,4-allenyl-cobalt branch, and current dual-Co/Ni general transformation. Prior and proposed chemistry was not promoted to current experiments.

regions.region: page 2 lower-left optimization narrative
regions.finding: Mapped the model 1a/2a reaction, 93% standard result, omission controls, Co(II)/NFTPB replacement, silane and catalyst variants to the fourteen Table 1 rows shown on page 3; no narrative duplicates were created.

regions.region: page 2 lower-right Scheme 2 scope discussion
regions.finding: Linked the R1/R2/R3 scope discussion to the 33 product arrows on page 4, including internal/terminal alkene variants and the continuation onto page 3. No aggregate prose range was substituted for row yields.

unresolved: The optimization table itself is on page 3; page-2 prose does not independently supply all row-specific amounts or outcomes.
Compact scope structures remain source-labeled where safe complete encoding was uncertain.

regions.region: page 3 upper-left Table 1 reaction header, entries 1-14, catalyst/ligand structures, and footnotes
regions.finding: Recorded all fourteen source rows independently with shared absolute charges, catalyst/ligand loadings, dry DMPU volume/concentration, 40 °C/24 h, 19F NMR basis, entry-1 isolated yield, omissions/replacements, n.d./trace/NR, and the 35-42% range. Source-combined rows 9 and 14 remain unresolved rather than being split into invented catalyst/solvent-specific yields.

regions.region: page 3 lower-left continuation of Scheme 2 and Scheme 3 scope discussion
regions.finding: Confirmed the 3Jb no-reaction row and linked every Scheme 3 successful, alternative-electrophile, scale-up, late-stage, and narrative alkyl-iodide-failure record to the page-5 arrows/prose. The alkyl iodide identity and oxidation product remain missing.

regions.region: page 3 right-column Scheme 4 discussion
regions.finding: Recorded TEMPO inhibition, two radical clocks, deuterium labeling, complex-11 preparation/reactivity, and three complex-11 cross-coupling experiments independently. The Scheme-4 eq-3 12-yield conflict is retained as 5% prose versus <5% figure evidence.

regions.region: page 3 lower-right proposed-mechanism prose
regions.finding: Classified Co(III)-H formation, propargyl/allenyl radicals, and allenyl-Co(III) cage-pair species as a proposed mechanism record, not preparations.

unresolved: Table 1 rows 9 and 14 each combine two variants without per-variant outcomes.
The source reports Scheme 4 eq-3 product 12 as 5% in prose and <5% in the figure.
Theoretical at-most-10% discussion is mechanistic reasoning, not an experimental outcome.

regions.region: page 4 Scheme 2 full reaction header, 33 product arrows, caption, and footnote
regions.finding: Recorded every distinct 3bb-3Jb arrow under its displayed aryl partner and shared 0.1/0.3 mmol, 2 equiv silane, 10 mol% Co/Ni/L1, 1.0 mL dry DMPU, 40 °C, 24 h conditions. The 3Jb source marker remains no reaction and was not converted to zero.

regions.region: page 4 lower-left continuation of proposed nickel/cobalt cycle
regions.finding: Classified LNi(I) oxidative addition, cage electron/ligand transfer, allenyl-Ni(III) reductive elimination, and the possible E' route as proposed steps. No mechanistic intermediate was treated as an isolated experiment.

regions.region: page 4 lower-right conclusion
regions.finding: Conclusion restates the reaction class and adds no independent experiment, dose, yield, or selectivity result.

unresolved: Scheme 2 omits row-specific workups, purifications, isolated masses, atmosphere, and explicit yield bases.
Mechanistic intermediates are proposed and unquantified.

regions.region: page 5 Scheme 3 reaction header and products 4a-4w
regions.finding: Recorded all 23 aryl-iodide product arrows with their depicted 1A/1K enyne class, shared condition set, and reported yields. Compact aryl/product structures remain source-labeled where safe encoding was uncertain.

regions.region: page 5 Scheme 3 alternative electrophiles, 3 mmol scale-up, and 4x-4z late-stage arrows
regions.finding: Recorded bromo/chloro/triflate 3aa experiments separately, preserving <5% as an upper bound; recorded the 3.0 mmol/0.898 g/80% scale-up without calculating unprinted scaled charges; recorded cholesterol-, pantolactone-, and vitamin-E-derived rows with product-targeted crude-NMR dr values.

regions.region: page 5 Scheme 3 caption and footnotes a-f
regions.finding: Applied shared quantities/conditions and footnote-specific electrophile replacements, crude-1H-NMR dr basis, and scale-up marker to their own records. Footnote reagents are participants rather than notes-only exceptions.

regions.region: page 5 Associated Content and Supporting Information statement
regions.finding: The publisher states that experimental procedures and spectra are available online, but no SI file is explicitly associated in the workspace; no SI-only procedure or result was inferred.

unresolved: Scheme 3 omits row-specific workups, purifications, most isolated masses, atmosphere, and explicit yield bases.
The alkyl-iodide failure lacks exact substrate identity, numerical conversion/recovery, and oxidation-product identity.
Online SI availability is not workspace SI association.

regions.region: page 6 Scheme 4a radical inhibition
regions.finding: Recorded the 1j/2b/TEMPO 50 mol% experiment: desired 3jb not detected, oxidation product 5 reported at 15%, and depicted TEMPO adduct 6 not observed.

regions.region: page 6 Scheme 4b-c radical clocks and deuterium labeling
regions.finding: Recorded 7->8 (38%), diene 9->10 (35%, cis/trans 5:1), and the distinct Ph2SiD2 reaction to d1-3cb (41%, >95% D, 0.95 D at the alkene terminus) with displayed conditions.

regions.region: page 6 Scheme 4d preparation of arylnickel(II) 11
regions.finding: Recorded one two-stage preparation with THF/room-temperature overnight coordination followed by ethyl 4-iodobenzoate (1 equiv) at room temperature for 1 h, yielding complex 11 in 71%. Stage temperatures and times remain paired and ordered.

regions.region: page 6 Scheme 4e three complex-11 cross-coupling arrows
regions.finding: Recorded the 10 mol% complex-11 precatalyst reaction (12, 58%), stoichiometric 11 without aryl iodide (12, <5%/trace), and stoichiometric 11 with 2b (3cb 54%; 12 <5% in figure but 5% in prose) as separate experiments.

regions.region: page 6 author/contact continuation
regions.finding: Administrative material only; no additional reaction, condition, outcome, or SI association is present below Scheme 4.

unresolved: Scheme 4 omits many absolute charges, solvent volumes, atmospheres, workups, purifications, isolated masses, yield bases, and detection limits.
Scheme 4e eq 3 conflicts with prose for product 12: <5% versus 5%.
The TEMPO/radical-clock yields and selectivity bases are not explicitly identified.
